purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing - specifically point aggregation by diagnosis category (診療区分別点数集計) for medical billing claims
purpose.summary: ORCR0030 is a large batch program in the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software system. It aggregates and edits medical treatment points by diagnosis category for generating insurance claim receipts (レセプト). The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2000-2006 covering various Japanese health insurance system reforms.

notable_features: Extensive Japanese-language comments in EUC-JP/latin-1 encoded text
58 COPY statements indicating heavy use of JMA ORCA copybooks
60 CALL statements for modular subprogram architecture
1040 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Detailed revision history with version numbers from 2000-2006
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded text visible as garbled latin-1 characters in comments. This is the JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association standard receipt software) system, an open-source medical billing platform. The program ORCR0030 handles receipt point aggregation by medical treatment category. Source truncated to first 16000 chars but mechanical indicators confirm full file is 28184 lines / 1.36MB.
